author: priya-raman
title: Stale account balances in three reconciliation runs
body:
## Summary

Three reconciliation runs (2025-09-29, 2025-10-06 and 2025-10-14) reported balances that were out of date by the amount of that night's settlement. Total mis-statement across the three runs was €1,204.50.

## What we know

- The balance reader serves snapshots from the cache.
- The nightly import updates the ledger and then deletes the affected cache keys.
- The matcher starts at 02:30 and sometimes reads a key between the ledger write and the delete, then writes the old value back. The stale value survives until the next import.

## Impact

Finance saw false exceptions and spent time clearing them by hand. No money moved incorrectly.

## Next step

Fix the race or remove the cache. I am measuring how much the cache helps before choosing.
